result.rationale: The server schema (addGuests.schema.ts) is only `z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness refine, while the handler does filter guests already present in booking.attendees but does not deduplicate within the submitted guests array itself. So a direct API call with duplicate emails (e.g. ["a@b.com","a@b.com"]) would create duplicate attendee records via createMany. The uniqueness check exists only in the client-side AddGuestsDialog schema. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff.
